verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI's automations are file-based: non-interactive scripts (gh-6), GEMINI.md context files (gh-9) and MCP config in ~/.gemini/settings.json (gh-19). That implies they can be versioned and reviewed in ordinary source control, and conversation checkpointing (gh-8) offers a save/resume point. None of the evidence documents first-class versioning, review, or rollback of automations themselves. Missing for 10: explicit automation version history, a built-in review/diff workflow for automation changes, documented rollback/restore of automations or their effects, and independent corroboration.
